uiUx: Zero raw Unicode emojis in UI components.
Theme-aware colors only (no hardcoded `#fff`/`#000`); WCAG AA >=4.5:1 contrast in Light & Dark.
8pt grid (`8,16,24,32`); max 1 primary CTA per screen/modal; outcome-first CTA copy; linked `<label>` on all inputs.

Customer UI Copy Policy: pair domain brand terms (`<brand-terms>`) with `<TermTooltip>` + canonical setup doc links (`/docs/<guide>`); render human-readable tier names via `formatTierName()` (ban raw DB enums in UI); ban internal engineering jargon (`OAuth`/`SSRF`/`RBAC`/`Zod`/`RSC`/`403`/`500`/DB errors/config keys) in customer alerts/banners/pricing (provider setup forms keep exact labels + plain-English helper text + doc link).
coreProduction: Strict TypeScript: Zero `any` (validate external payloads with Zod); `catch (error: unknown)`; `'use server';` on line 1 of Server Actions.
Modularity: <=200 non-empty lines per file (`src/__tests__` exempt); no nested ternaries.
Security: Enforce server-side auth/entitlement checks, bounded Zod `.max()` inputs, rate limiting, and webhook idempotency.
